name: Return to Deliana
label: Quest
description: Return to Deliana: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It's been great working with you, friend. Here is the finished product.
I hope it helps you in your current endeavors. And hey, if you don't mind, help spread the word. I wouldn't mind having more customers!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent! You've done well, friend. I'm not sure I trust the goblin's craftsmanship, but I'm left with no other choice.
